cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The wedding venue has changed our booking. Sit with me a moment; I taught you to take one planning problem at a time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're asking before panicking this time. The date is still ours, but we can't use the building.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fire. Nobody was hurt. We'll keep the date and find somewhere else together. You don't have to ring anyone yet; take that one thing at a time, as we practised.
